publication: Owner-authorized consolidated main publication on 2026-10-29 (ADR-083); remote CI not run
formula: (light - bias - (dark - bias) * t_light/t_dark) / normalized flat + pedestal

rules.pedestal: rounded median of master bias, else master dark
rules.dark_defect_rule: light holds less than half the scaled thermal signal, or the sample would go negative; replaced by the median of calibrated same-phase neighbours
rules.flat_normalization: per 2x2 phase median; values outside 0.05..20 not divided
rules.flat_offset: master dark flat, else master bias; integer master flats without OFFSETRM=T get it subtracted when calibration is prepared
rules.accuracy_witness_fallback: anchor's 1000 precise stars within 3 px when the ordinary witnesses are too few and coverage passes

asi2600mm_sadr_dualband.note: right corners show a sky gradient; flats at rotator 179 deg vs lights 2 deg

asi2600mc_flaming_star.masters: ASIAIR bias, dark (no EXPTIME), flat (integer, offset subtracted here)

dwarf3_mini_c20.rejected_alternative: global dark optimization per light: 25C 1419->298, 36C 293->12085 negatives
